items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: No, not a record with the band. Edgar Keller. ... We wasn't using two trumpets at that time.

ctx.x: Once Ricard Alexis joined. Well, he made a record with us. He didn't play all the time?
No, not a record with the band. Edgar Keller.
Oh, he was with him then. Edgar Keller. Yeah. He's the one they call Guy Keller. Guy Keller.
